startup.description: Fresh release process evaluating an empty script; Engine/Realm installation and process overhead, no JavaScript tier compilation. Separate thirty interleaved process pairs pinned CPU 5.
startup.comparison: Median of paired process wall-time ratios; percentile bootstrap, 50000 resamples of thirty pairs, seed 20261013.

compilation_and_size.description: DataView classification is consumed by the existing call-hit helper; the ARM64 and x86-64 template emitters are unchanged by this isolated candidate. No additional per-JavaScript-function native compilation policy is introduced.
compilation_and_size.compilation_timing: Not compared: release builds ran under different compilation load. The shared session separately evaluates function tiering and application compilation volume.

inherited_constructor_behavior.description: Invalid byteOffset and an already detached buffer still cause a supplied byteLength object to coerce before the constructor throws. This behavior predates the DataView access optimization and is unchanged by the isolated candidate. Production constructor ordering is outside this optimization.
